arxiv-2107-03981.title: Phase transition dynamics in the three-dimensional field-free ± \pm J Ising model
arxiv-2107-03981.creator: Ozan S. Sarıyer
arxiv-2107-03981.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Ozan S. Sarıyer. By using frustration-preserving hard-spin mean-field theory, we investigated the phase transition dynamics in the three-dimensional field-free ± J \pm J Ising spin glass model. As the temperature T T is decreased from paramagnetic phase at high temperatures, with a rate ω = − d T / d t \omega=-dT/dt in time t t , the critical temperature depends on the cooling rate through a clear power-law ω a \omega^{a} .

arxiv-2210-16063.title: Defense Against Smart Invaders with Swarms of Sweeping Agents
arxiv-2210-16063.creator: Roee M. Francos, Alfred M. Bruckstein
arxiv-2210-16063.description: Abstract The goal of this research is to devise guaranteed defense policies that allow to protect a given region from the entrance of smart mobile invaders by detecting them using a team of defending agents equipped with identical line sensors. By designing cooperative defense strategies that ensure all invaders are detected, conditions on the defenders’ speed are derived.

arxiv-2302-09496.title: An extension to “A subsemigroup of the rook monoid”
arxiv-2302-09496.creator: George Fikioris, Giannis Fikioris
arxiv-2302-09496.description: Abstract A recent paper studied an inverse submonoid M n M_{n} of the rook monoid, by representing the nonzero elements of M n M_{n} via certain triplets belonging to ℤ 3 \mathbb{Z}^{3} . In this short note, we allow the triplets to belong to ℝ 3 \mathbb{R}^{3} .

arxiv-2306-04510.title: Unified Model for Crystalline Material Generation
arxiv-2306-04510.creator: Astrid Klipfel, Yaël Frégier, Adlane Sayede, Zied Bouraoui
arxiv-2306-04510.description: Abstract One of the greatest challenges facing our society is the discovery of new innovative crystal materials with specific properties. Recently, the problem of generating crystal materials has received increasing attention, however, it remains unclear to what extent, or in what way, we can develop generative models that consider both the periodicity and equivalence geometric of crystal structures.

arxiv-2309-17126.title: Population Oscillations and Ubiquitous Coherences in multilevel quantum systems driven by incoherent radiation
arxiv-2309-17126.creator: Amro Dodin, Timur V. Tscherbul, Paul Brumer
arxiv-2309-17126.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Amro Dodin, Timur V. Tscherbul, Paul Brumer. We consider incoherent excitation of multilevel quantum systems, e.g. molecules with multiple vibronic states. We show that (1) the geometric constraints of the matter-field coupling operator guarantee that noise-induced coherences will be generated in all systems with four or more energy eigenstates and (2) noise-induced coherences can lead to population oscillations due to quantum interference via coherence transfer between pairs of states in the ground and excited manifolds.

arxiv-2404-15669.title: The Coupling Constant of the Pseudovector Pion-nucleon Interaction
arxiv-2404-15669.creator: for the Magnetic Moment of Nucleon
arxiv-2404-15669.description: Abstract The role of the suppression of the coupling constant in the pseudovector pion-nucleon interaction is examined to account for the calculation of the magnetic moment of nucleon. Among three kinds of the higher-order corrections the vacuum polarization of the pion propagator contributes to the numerical value considerably.

arxiv-2406-06115.title: The Rational rank of the support of generalized power series solutions of differential and q q -difference equations
arxiv-2406-06115.creator: J. Cano and P. Fortuny Ayuso
arxiv-2406-06115.description: Abstract . Given a differential or q q -difference equation P P of order n n , we prove that the set of exponents of a generalized power series solution has its rational rank bounded by the rational rank of the support of P P plus n n .

arxiv-2408-03428.title: Two-dimensional solitary water waves with constant vorticity, Part II: the deep capillary case
arxiv-2408-03428.creator: James Rowan, Lizhe Wan
arxiv-2408-03428.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by James Rowan, Lizhe Wan. We consider the two-dimensional capillary water waves with nonzero constant vorticity in infinite depth. We first derive the Babenko equation that describes the profile of the solitary wave. When the velocity c c is close to a critical velocity and a sign condition involving the physical parameters is met, the Babenko equation can be reduced to the stationary focusing cubic nonlinear Schrödinger equation plus perturbative error.

A spectrum-wide analysis of power requires attention to the fundamental principles that constrain these processes.

arxiv-2510-03246.title: StructPrune: Structured Global Pruning asymptotics with 𝒪 ⁡ ( N ) \mathcal{O}(\sqrt{N}) GPU Memory
arxiv-2510-03246.creator: Xinyuan Song, Guangji Bai, Liang Zhao
arxiv-2510-03246.description: Abstract Pruning is critical for scaling large language models (LLMs). Global pruning achieves strong performance but requires 𝒪 ⁡ ( N ) \mathcal{O}(N) memory, which is infeasible for billion-parameter models. Local pruning reduces GPU memory usage to that of a single layer by pruning layers independently, but it neglects inter-layer dependencies and often leads to suboptimal performance in high-sparsity regimes.

arxiv-2511-07786.title: A Closed-Form Framework for Schrödinger Bridges Between Arbitrary Densities
arxiv-2511-07786.creator: Hanwen Huang
arxiv-2511-07786.description: Abstract Score-based generative models have recently attracted significant attention for their ability to generate high-fidelity data by learning maps from simple Gaussian priors to complex data distributions. A natural generalization of this idea to transformations between arbitrary probability distributions leads to the Schrödinger Bridge (SB) problem.

Therefore, this study aimed to compare the time-course changes in cervical superficial muscle activation patterns among dental students with and without neck pain throughout their initial semester of clinical training.

pmc-11592309.title: Single-Channel Sleep EEG Classification Method Based on LSTM and Hidden Markov Model
pmc-11592309.creator: Wan Chen, Yanping Cai, Aihua Li, Yanzhao Su, Ke Jiang
pmc-11592309.description: Background: The single-channel sleep EEG has the advantages of convenient collection, high-cost performance, and easy daily use, and it has been widely used in the classification of sleep stages. This impact, in turn, results in poor academic performance or dropping out of university.

pmc-13367341.title: Elevated Hydrocarbon Exposure Escalates Coronary and Cerebrovascular Disease Risks: A Comprehensive Systematic Review
pmc-13367341.creator: Huma Sulthana, Manasa Kasoj, Shubham Kumar, Asif Jan, Daniel Dubwa
pmc-13367341.description: Exposure to hydrocarbons, including polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) and volatile organic compounds (VOCs), represents an escalating public health concern. These compounds induce systemic inflammation, oxidative stress, and endothelial dysfunction, driving cardiovascular disease (CVD) pathogenesis. This systematic review evaluates the association between hydrocarbon exposure and CVD risk, focusing on specific metabolite biomarkers.

uslaw-usc-t25-s337.title: 25 U.S.C. § 337 — Allotments in national forests
uslaw-usc-t25-s337.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t25-s337.description: United States Code, Title 25 (Indians); Chapter 9 (Allotment Of Indian Lands). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Secretary of the Interior is authorized, in his discretion, to make allotments within the national forests in conformity with the general allotment laws, to any Indian occupying, living on, or having improvements on land included within any such national forest who is not entitled.
